text: Undergraduate students may borrow up to 8 books at a time for a loan period of 14 days.
Staff members may borrow up to 20 books at a time for a loan period of 60 days.
Overdue books incur a fine of EUR 0.50 per book per day. Fines are not charged on public holidays.
Reference books are not available for loan and must be used inside the reading room.
Interlibrary loans are free for staff members and cost EUR 3 per request for students.
Group study rooms can be booked for up to 6 people for a maximum of 3 hours per day.
New laptops are covered by a three-year warranty that includes accidental damage.
Refurbished laptops are covered by a one-year warranty that excludes accidental damage.
Warranty claims must be submitted through the service desk within 30 days of the fault.
Warranty claims must be submitted through the service desk within 14 days of the fault.
